<!-- sharpforge-backlog:SF-A07-T21 -->

**Parent:** #539 (SF-A07-E04) · **Workstream:** A07 — BCL primitives text time and globalization · **Priority:** P0

## Deliverable

Add packages/bcl-core/src/system/object.js: Object.Equals (static and virtual), ReferenceEquals, GetHashCode (stable identity hash stored on the heap record), ToString default (type full name), MemberwiseClone, GetType bridge; ValueType field-wise Equals/GetHashCode; Boolean Parse/TryParse/ToString/CompareTo/TrueString/FalseString.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Struct default Equals compares fields; identity hash survives GC compaction and snapshots; bool.Parse(" TRUE ") is true.

- [ ] Positive, negative and boundary tests added; every affected engine/platform verified, unsupported targets recorded explicitly.

## Ownership

**Owns:** `packages/bcl-core/src/system/object.js`. Workstream write scope: `packages/bcl-core/**`. Shared hot files (`compiler/src/index.js`, `syntax/src/parser.js`, runtime dispatchers, `framework/src/index.js`, `studio.js`) are edited only through the A00 seams or with an explicit lock recorded in the project's **Lock keys** field.

## Claiming

Claim this task directly if it has no sub-issues; otherwise claim one of its sub-issues. Set **Agent**, **Lease expires** and **Branch** on the project item and move **Status** to *Claimed*.
